title: Winter trees down the street show their branches and twigs
items: With the Season set to winter, the bare elms along the streets from about 10 m out, and the woods' trees further off, had shrunk to a trunk and a few long poles, because the leaf that covers the fine wood in summer was gone and nothing drew the wood in its place.
They now carry their branches and a fringe of twigs, so a street of winter elms greys in round its limbs the way Taylor's winter photograph of the Pullman estate shows it.
Summer, spring and fall trees are unchanged, and a winter tree draws no more than the same tree in leaf.
